blocks.value: In recognition of exceptional advocacy skills, rigorous legal analysis,
and outstanding performance in the National Moot Court Competition
2025. Through persuasive oral arguments, comprehensive legal
research, and exemplary courtroom demeanor, the above-named
participant has demonstrated the qualities of excellence expected of
future leaders of the legal profession.
Miss Henderson's advocacy demonstrated exceptional command of
legal principles, strategic argumentation, and professional courtroom

presence. Her performance set a benchmark for excellence in 
appellate advocacy.

Award Certificate No: NMCC-2025-AWARD-184
Royal Courts of Justice Sponsored by 
The Supreme Court of the United Kingdom
